activity.notes: Amoghavarsha I conventionally reigned over the Rashtrakuta Empire from 814 to 878. His early reign was disrupted by rebellion and he had regained his regal position by 821; the record preserves the conventional regnal span rather than inventing an unsourced interruption interval.

sources.title: SOUTH INDIA
sources.citation_text: The historical survey identifies Govinda III's successor as Amoghavarsha I (A.D. 814-878) and notes that he regained his regal position in A.D. 821 after early disruption.
